ADB Internship Program 2025 is an opportunity offered by the Asian Development Bank (a regional development bank headquartered in the Ortigas Center located in Mandaluyong, Metro Manila, Philippines) to students enrolled in master's or Ph.D. degrees. This internship program is a project-oriented learning opportunity for graduate students to gain experience through research assignments based on ADB’s current operational needs. The selected candidates will receive a stipend for the duration of the internship.
To be eligible, an applicant must:-
be a national of ADB member country, including India
be enrolled in a master's or Ph.D. level program at a school in one of the ADB member nations, both before and after the internship assignment
be engaged in academic study in a field directly related to ADB's work
possess an excellent command of English
have professional experience relevant to the assignment

The selected candidates will receive a stipend for the duration of the internship. An exception to receiving a stipend would be for interns who fall under the special arrangement category between selected schools and the Asian Development Bank (ADB).

ADB will evaluate the applications based on the following factors:
relevance of academic study and work experience
level of interest and motivation to contribute to development work
ADB also considers institutional representation, gender, and nationality balance in the overall intern selection process of the interns.
Applications submitted after the deadline will not be considered.
To avoid errors in submission, applicants are advised not to wait until the last day of the application period to submit their internship applications.
The interns are not allowed to travel during the internship assignment.
ADB will not accept applications from close relatives of ADB staff.
Past interns are ineligible to apply for another internship with ADB.
Completing an internship does not automatically qualify for employment with ADB. However, ADB welcomes former interns to apply for jobs after they graduate from school.
